channel.desc: Ardingly in Sussex is the location for today's programme. Christina Trevanion is in charge, with experts Nick Hall and Ochuko Ojiri helping the red and blue teams as they spend ?300 on antiques. Christina looks at the art and history of Persian carpets. As usual, the teams face profits and losses at the auction, but which team will come out on top?
